@graph.name: Flit - Personal Note Taking & Knowledge Management | Features
@graph.description: Take notes, transcribe voice recordings, organise with categories and bi-directional links, import and export freely, and sync across devices with Flit.

@graph.name: What you can do with Flit

itemListElement.name: Take Notes and Transcribe Voice Recordings
itemListElement.description: Write naturally or speak your thoughts, Flit instantly turns voice recordings into clean, structured notes.

itemListElement.name: Organise your Notes
itemListElement.description: Sort notes into categories and build connections between them with bi-directional links. Every link shows you how your ideas relate and helps you navigate your knowledge with ease.

itemListElement.name: Full Import & Export
itemListElement.description: Bring your existing notes from other apps or export everything whenever you want. Your data is never locked in.

itemListElement.name: Multi-Device Sync and Backup
itemListElement.description: Your notes stay in perfect sync across web and your devices. Automatic backups give you total peace of mind.
